description: List the step types (actions) available in Speak's automation catalog, optionally for one app slug, plus the fields each filter or condition step can test. For a third-party app this includes every action it offers (push), each with a configSchema for the step's argsTemplate, a group, and requiresConfirmation with a riskKind (send, post, share or delete) when the step needs composio.acknowledged: true before it can be saved. Deprecated actions are marked; pick a replacement. An action the flow cannot feed carries needsInput ({ reason, hint, next }): after an email or file trigger, next is create_folder_automation, which means import with speak-upload here and act in a linked folder automation (see create_automation's linkedAutomationBody). Read-only: listing an action does not run it.

afterTrigger.description: Slug of the trigger the step will follow, so each action's needsInput hint fits what that trigger brings.

q.description: Search action names, descriptions and groups, e.g. "create task". Without app it searches every connected app.
